        - Test: continuously test products, creatives, hooks, audiences and messaging, with a weekly UGC ad cadence and a 45+ hook and angle matrix.

        - Optimize: improve CAC, conversion rate, AOV, ROAS and overall profitability, including checkout friction removal and in-cart offers.

        - Scale: put more budget, creative and resources behind what is working: daily budget scaling, a high-volume creative lab, new channels and markets, and 90-day LTV.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What does a DTC marketing agency do?
A DTC marketing agency grows brands that sell direct to consumers online. It plans and runs paid campaigns measured on revenue, new-customer cost and ROAS, and usually also owns the ad creative, the store experience and email. Brand Scaling does this for Shopify brands across Meta, TikTok and Google as one ecommerce growth system.

### How much does an ecommerce growth agency cost?
Most agencies charge a monthly retainer, a percentage of ad spend, a performance fee or a mix. Brand Scaling quotes after the [Brand Growth Audit](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/book), and partners typically spend at least $10,000 to $20,000 a month on ads.

### What types and sizes of ecommerce brands do you work with?
DTC and ecommerce brands doing roughly $20K to $2M+ a month with proven product-market fit, in apparel, skincare and beauty, wellness, supplements, home goods, electronics and luxury goods.

### How quickly will we see results?
The first 7 to 14 days cover the diagnostic audit, account restructure, product page and offer rebuild and tracking setup. Most brands see measurable improvement in CPA, AOV and ROAS within 2 to 4 weeks of the first creative wave.

### How do you measure marketing performance?
We report on blended numbers first ([MER](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/glossary/mer), new customer CAC, [contribution margin](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/glossary/contribution-margin)) and on platform ROAS second, because platform ROAS alone over-credits ads.

### Do you handle creative scripting, UGC production, and video editing?
Yes, 100%. [Direct-response creative](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/viral-creatives) is the #1 lever for Meta and TikTok ad performance today. We write data-backed scripts, source creators, produce UGC and motion design assets, and deploy 30–50+ angle iterations each month so your ad accounts never hit fatigue.

### Which agencies are best for scaling DTC ecommerce brands?
The best agencies for scaling DTC brands combine algorithmic media buying (Meta Advantage+, [TikTok Shop](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/tiktok-shop-agency), Google PMax) with in-house direct-response video production and Shopify [conversion rate optimization](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/cro-agency) (CRO). Unlike traditional marketing agencies that charge for impressions, Brand Scaling aligns media spend directly to contribution margin and blended MER.

### How does Brand Scaling compare to agencies like KlientBoost or traditional media buyers?
Traditional PPC agencies like KlientBoost often manage ad traffic in isolation, leaving you to solve video creative and website conversion on your own. Brand Scaling operates as a full-stack growth partner: our team scripts and shoots 15-30+ vertical video creatives every month, rebuilds high-converting Shopify product pages, and optimizes unit economics.

### What makes Brand Scaling a true DTC brand accelerator?
As a [DTC brand accelerator](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/blog/how-to-scale-a-dtc-brand) founded by Gaurav Kapoor ($50M+ ad spend managed, 150+ [case studies](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/case-studies)), we install proven 8-figure scaling infrastructure into your business: validated direct-response video frameworks, broad Advantage+ campaign architectures, 1-click post-purchase upsells, and lifecycle Klaviyo automations.

### How do you scale DTC brands using retargeting without burning budget?
Post-iOS 14, small micro-targeted retargeting ad sets cause audience frequency fatigue and high CPMs. We scale brands using dynamic catalog ads, broad Advantage+ audience consolidation, custom 180-day video-engagement custom audiences, and high-converting 1-click email/SMS flows that capture abandoned carts profitably.

### How do you scale Meta ads for an 8-figure DTC brand?
At that size the limits are creative volume and margin, not targeting. We consolidate into a few broad or Advantage+ campaigns, raise budgets in steps of about 20% while blended MER and new-customer CAC hold, feed the account new hooks and angles every week, and use a break-even ROAS from contribution margin as the floor. Scaling stops when MER falls below target, not when platform ROAS dips for a day.

### Do you offer TikTok Shop and Google Ads scaling alongside Meta Ads?
Yes. While Meta Ads serve as the core customer acquisition engine for visual discovery, we scale brands holistically with TikTok Shop affiliate networks, native TikTok UGC ads, and Google Search & Performance Max (PMax) campaigns to capture high-intent brand and competitor search volume.

# The Ecommerce Growth Engine: Meta, TikTok, Google and Shopify CRO in One System
URL: https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/growth
Summary: The Brand Scaling growth engine for DTC brands: Meta and TikTok media buying, creative, Shopify CRO and retention run as one system. See how it works.

Brand Scaling is an ecommerce growth agency that runs paid acquisition, creative, the store and retention together, so the fixes in one area do not get lost in another. Over $50M+ in ad spend managed across 150+ verified case studies.

## How do you choose an ecommerce growth agency?
Choose an ecommerce growth agency that can show real results in your price range and niche, produces creative in-house, and reports on blended MER and contribution margin rather than platform ROAS alone. Ask who owns your ad accounts and store, how many new creatives you get each month, and what happens in the first 90 days.

      
## What an Ecommerce Growth Agency Does

      A growth agency is measured on business outcomes — revenue, cost per acquisition (CAC), and net contribution margin. Traditional agencies manage dashboards in isolation; we align creative volume, media buying, and Shopify checkout speed into a single feedback loop.

      
## The Four Phases of Our Growth Engine

      
        - Phase 1 — Foundation: Offer setup, sub-1s mobile Shopify, unit margin economics.

        - Phase 2 — Test: Weekly UGC ad cadence, 45+ hook and angle matrix, Advantage+ audience testing.

        - Phase 3 — Optimize: Conversion rate, ROAS and margin health, checkout friction removal.

        - Phase 4 — Scale: High-volume creative lab (40+ assets a month), global market expansion.

      
    
## Frequently Asked Questions

### What does an ecommerce growth agency do?
An [ecommerce growth agency](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/) runs paid acquisition, creative, the store and retention as one system and is measured on revenue, new-customer CAC and [contribution margin](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/glossary/contribution-margin). Brand Scaling combines Meta, TikTok and Google media buying with [direct-response creative](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/viral-creatives) production and [Shopify CRO](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/cro-agency), so a fix in one area is not lost in another.

### Is TikTok Shop part of the growth engine?
Yes. Creator affiliate selling is one of the six levers in the growth engine: we recruit and brief affiliates, run [Spark Ads](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/tiktok-ads-agency) on the best creator videos and connect the shop catalog to the same offer and margin model used on Meta. How we run it is on our [TikTok Shop scaling services](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/tiktok-shop-agency) page.

### Are you an ecommerce marketing agency based in the USA?
Yes. Brand Scaling Hacks LLC is headquartered at 27 W 24th Street, Suite 702, New York, NY 10010, and works with DTC brands across the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada and Australia.

### Do you handle email and SMS marketing for ecommerce brands?
Yes. [Klaviyo email](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/klaviyo-email-sms-agency) and SMS lifecycle retention is part of the engine: welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase and win-back flows are built to raise repeat purchase rate and LTV so the account can afford a higher CAC on paid channels.

### How is a growth agency different from a performance marketing agency?
A [performance marketing agency](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/blog/performance-marketing-agency) focuses on paid media results. A growth agency owns the full loop around the media: creative volume, store conversion rate, average order value and retention. Brand Scaling does both, which is why the engagement starts with a Brand Growth Audit rather than an ad account handover.

### Which agency creates Instagram Reels and TikTok videos for brands, and what does it cost?
Brand Scaling scripts, sources creators for and edits short vertical videos (UGC, founder-led and product demos) for Instagram Reels, TikTok and Meta ads, and runs them in the ad accounts it manages, so each video is judged on CPA and ROAS rather than views. Creative is priced as part of the growth engagement and quoted after the Brand Growth Audit; partners typically spend at least $10,000 to $20,000 a month on ads.

### What results should a $50K-a-month brand expect in 90 days?
In the first 14 days we fix tracking, offer and the product page; by day 45 most accounts have 2 to 3 proven creative concepts; by day 90 the target is a stable scaling budget at or above break-even ROAS with new-customer CAC trending down. Published case studies include $146,184 in 27 days at 3.64x ROAS and $2.3M in sales at 11.6x ROAS.

      Growth agencies usually charge a monthly retainer, a percentage of ad spend, a performance fee, or a combination. Brand Scaling quotes after the [Brand Growth Audit](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/book), once the scope is clear, and does not publish fixed prices because two brands at the same revenue can need very different work.

# Shopify Growth Agency for DTC Brands That Want More Revenue Per Visitor
URL: https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/shopify-agency
Summary: DTC Shopify agency for growth: store builds, redesigns and CRO for paid traffic, sub-1s mobile pages, bundles and upsells. Book a store audit.

A Shopify agency that builds and optimizes stores for paid traffic: every page is built for the ads that send visitors to it. Proven by verified 5.25% store conversion rate results.

## When does a DTC brand need a Shopify growth agency?
A DTC brand needs a Shopify growth agency when paid traffic is growing but revenue per visitor is not. A Shopify growth agency rebuilds the store around the ads sending traffic: offer, product page, bundles, upsells and speed, so each visitor is worth more and the ad account can afford to scale.

      
## What a Shopify Growth Agency Does

      Unlike design shops that simply install aesthetic themes, a growth-focused Shopify agency ties store architecture directly to your Meta and TikTok media buying. We eliminate checkout friction, engineer quantity breaks, optimize mobile speed under 1 second, and lift Average Order Value (AOV) so paid campaigns scale profitably.

      
## Verified Store Conversion Proofs

      
        - $61,000 monthly revenue at 5.25% conversion rate on clinical skincare store

        - $24,098 in a single day with 292 orders on a brand-new Shopify launch

        - $80,000 in 24 hours with 862 orders on a DTC fitness store

      
    
## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is conversion work part of your Shopify service?
Yes. On every Shopify build we audit mobile speed, product pages, offers and checkout, and add bundles and post-purchase upsells that lift [average order value](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/glossary/aov), matched to the Meta and [TikTok ads](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/tiktok-ads-agency) sending the traffic. Ongoing A/B testing and the full research process are covered on our DTC [ecommerce CRO agency](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/cro-agency) page.

### Can you help a marketplace-dependent brand grow its own DTC channel?
Yes. Brands that rely on Amazon or other marketplaces usually move to owned-channel growth in three steps: a Shopify store built to convert paid traffic, Meta and TikTok ads that send new customers there, and [email and SMS](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/klaviyo-email-sms-agency) retention so repeat orders come back to the store instead of the marketplace.

### What is a Shopify agency?
A Shopify agency designs, builds, and optimizes online stores on the Shopify platform. While traditional agencies focus only on visuals, Brand Scaling focuses on conversion rate optimization and unit economics, ensuring every landing page is engineered around the paid ads driving traffic.

### What is a Shopify Plus agency?
A Shopify Plus agency works with enterprise and high-volume merchants processing $1M+ annually, configuring checkout extensibility, custom B2B portals, advanced Shopify Flow automations, and international expansion stores.

### How much is Shopify Plus per month?
Shopify Plus standard plans start at approximately $2,000 per month for standard licensing or a variable fee based on transaction volume for high-revenue merchants. Check Shopify's official pricing page for real-time updates.

### How do I choose the best Shopify agency in the USA?
Evaluate live conversion rate [case studies](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/case-studies) rather than static portfolios. Verify that the agency understands paid acquisition (Meta/TikTok), confirms you maintain 100% code ownership, and runs ongoing A/B hypothesis testing after launch.

### How long does a Shopify store rebuild take?
Our diagnostic audit and rapid rebuild of core revenue pages (Homepage, Product Display Page, Cart Drawer, and Offer Bundles) are deployed within the first 7 to 14 days, followed by continuous monthly CRO sprints.

      
## What a DTC Shopify agency does

      A DTC Shopify agency builds and improves Shopify stores for brands that sell their own products direct to consumers, usually with paid social as the main traffic source. That is different from a general web design agency: the store is judged on conversion rate, [average order value](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/glossary/aov) and revenue per session, not on how it looks in a portfolio.
Our Shopify work covers three areas, all tied to the ads that send the traffic.

      - Store builds and redesigns: new Shopify stores and rebuilds of existing ones, with fast mobile pages and product pages written around the angles that win in your ads.
- [Shopify CRO](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/cro-agency): product page, offer, bundle and checkout tests, measured on revenue per session.
- AOV and retention: bundles, post-purchase upsells and the [email and SMS flows](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/klaviyo-email-sms-agency) that follow the first order.

      
      
      - [DTC ecommerce CRO agency](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/cro-agency)

    
      
## How to choose a Shopify agency for scaling a DTC brand

      Shopify agencies fall into two groups, and DTC brands often hire the wrong one. Design and development studios build beautiful stores and hand them over. Growth agencies treat the store as part of the ad funnel and keep changing it after launch, because the product page that converts cold paid traffic is rarely the one that looks best in a portfolio.
If your traffic comes mainly from Meta and [TikTok ads](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/tiktok-ads-agency), choose an agency that will commit to numbers after launch, not only to a launch date. Ask these questions on the first call.

      - Will you change the store after launch, and how often do you test product pages, offers and bundles?
- Do you plan the page around the ads that send traffic to it (the same angle, offer and proof)?
- Which numbers do you report: conversion rate, revenue per session and AOV by traffic source, or only page speed scores?
- Who owns the theme, apps and code if we stop working together?
- Can you show a store you rebuilt and what happened to its conversion rate? Ours: a clinical skincare store reached a 5.25 percent conversion rate in a $61,000 month.

      
      
      
    
      
## What a store built for paid traffic needs

      A store built for organic and returning visitors can look good and still lose money on cold paid traffic. Someone arriving from a 15-second video knows almost nothing about the brand, so the page has to finish the job the ad started. When we build or rebuild a Shopify store for a growth engagement, these are the parts we work on first.

      - A landing page or product page that repeats the ad's promise above the fold.
- Reviews, before-and-after proof or demonstrations near the add to cart button, not at the bottom of the page.
- An offer that is easy to understand in a few seconds: one price, one bundle choice, one reason to buy now.
- A sticky add to cart on mobile and a cart drawer instead of a separate cart page.
- Post-purchase upsells shown after payment, so they add order value without slowing checkout.
- Fewer apps, compressed images and lighter scripts so the page loads fast on a phone connection.

      
      
      
    
      
## Shopify growth work and CRO: how they split

      This page covers the Shopify growth side: store builds and rebuilds, offers, bundles, upsells, speed and the connection between the store and the ads. Conversion rate optimisation as an ongoing testing program, with hypotheses, A/B tests and a monthly test roadmap, now has its own page.
Most brands need both, in order. The rebuild fixes the obvious problems quickly. The CRO program then finds the smaller gains that only show up in testing, such as which headline, bundle layout or guarantee wording converts better for your traffic.

      
      
      
      - [Ecommerce CRO agency](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/cro-agency)

    
      
## The Shopify numbers we track every week

      Conversion rate on its own can mislead. A discount can raise it while profit falls, and a higher-priced bundle can lower it while revenue per visitor rises. We read the store numbers together, and always next to the ad account, because a change in traffic quality shows up in the store before it shows up in ROAS.

      
      MetricWhat it tells youRevenue per sessionThe single best summary of store performance for paid trafficConversion rateWhether visitors who arrive go on to buyAverage order valueWhether bundles, quantity breaks and upsells are workingAdd to cart rateWhether the product page and offer persuadeCheckout completion rateWhether shipping costs, payment options or surprises lose buyers lateMobile load timeWhether slow pages are wasting paid clicks
      
      - [Conversion rate calculator](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/tools/conversion-rate-calculator)

    
      
## After the first order: connecting the store to retention

      A Shopify store also collects the email addresses, phone numbers and purchase history that retention runs on. During a rebuild we set up sign-up capture, post-purchase pages and the customer data that Klaviyo needs, so welcome, abandoned cart and repeat purchase flows can start as soon as traffic arrives. Repeat orders are what let the ads pay more for the first one.

      
      
      
      - [Klaviyo email and SMS agency](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/klaviyo-email-sms-agency)

# Meta Ads Agency for Ecommerce Brands That Need Profitable Scale
URL: https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/meta-ads-agency
Summary: Meta ads agency for DTC ecommerce: $50M+ Facebook and Instagram ad spend managed, creative testing, Advantage+ scaling and CAPI tracking. Book an audit.

Facebook and Instagram ads run as one system with the creative, the tracking and the Shopify store. $50M+ in Meta ad spend managed across 30+ niches, with 150+ verified case studies from real ad accounts.

## Why hire a Meta ads agency for ecommerce instead of running ads yourself?
A Meta ads agency for ecommerce brings creative volume, tested account structures and benchmarks from many stores, which a founder running ads alone rarely has time to build. It makes sense once you spend $10K+ a month and efficiency drops as budget rises. Below that, learning the basics yourself is often cheaper.

      
## What a Meta Ads Agency Does for an Ecommerce Brand

      A Meta ads agency plans, builds and runs Facebook and Instagram campaigns that are judged on revenue, cost per acquisition and ROAS, not impressions. Brand Scaling also produces the direct-response creative, validates Conversions API tracking against Shopify orders and fixes the product page the ads land on.

      
## Three Pillars: Creative Testing, Advantage+ Structure, Tracking

      
        - Creative Testing Engine: 30 to 50+ direct-response angles a month on a 45+ hook and angle matrix.

        - Advantage+ Account Structure: consolidated campaigns, broad targeting and cost controls.

        - Tracking and Unit Economics: Conversions API validated weekly, blended MER and new-customer CAC reporting.

      
      
## Meta Ads Results From Real Client Accounts

      
        - $2.3M in sales at 11.6x ROAS on $200K ad spend

        - $1.6M on $140K ad spend at 11.98x ROAS

        - $146,184 in 27 days on $40.1K spend for a skincare brand, 3.64x ROAS

        - €118,000 in the first month for a UK skincare brand

      
      
## How We Scale a Meta Ads Account in 90 Days

      
        - Foundation (days 1 to 14): tracking audit, CAPI fix, offer and margin review, first creative batch.

        - Test (days 15 to 45): weekly UGC drops, hook and angle matrix, Advantage+ audience tests.

        - Optimize (days 45 to 90): conversion rate, AOV and ROAS tuned together.

        - Scale (day 90 onward): 20% to 30% budget steps, cost caps, 40+ new assets a month.

      
      [Ecommerce growth agency](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/growth) | [Direct-response creatives](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/viral-creatives) | [Shopify agency](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/shopify-agency) | [Free ROAS calculator](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/roas-calculator) | [150+ case studies](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/case-studies)

    
## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can a Meta ads agency improve my ecommerce ROAS?
Usually, if the account has room in creative, structure or tracking. The biggest ROAS improvements we see come from more and better creative, consolidating into fewer broad campaigns, fixing [Conversions API](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/glossary/conversions-api) tracking and raising order value with bundles. We start every engagement with an audit that shows where your ROAS is being lost.

### What does a Meta ads agency do for an ecommerce brand?
A Meta ads agency plans, builds and runs Facebook and Instagram campaigns that are measured on revenue, cost per acquisition and ROAS. Brand Scaling also produces the direct-response video creative, validates Conversions API tracking and ties the ads to the Shopify store, because media buying alone cannot fix a weak offer or a slow product page.

### How much does a Meta ads agency cost?
Most ecommerce Meta ads agencies charge a monthly retainer, a percentage of ad spend, or a mix of both. Brand Scaling works with brands spending at least $10,000 to $20,000 per month on paid ads, and every engagement starts with a [Brand Growth Audit](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/book) so you see the plan and the numbers before any fee is agreed.

### What is a good ROAS for Meta ads?
[A good ROAS](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/blog/good-roas-for-ecommerce) depends on gross margin. A store with 60% margin breaks even at 1.67x ROAS, a store with 40% margin needs 2.5x just to break even. Our client accounts typically run between 3x and 6x on scale, with top accounts such as $2.3M in sales at 11.6x ROAS on $200K spend. Use the [free ROAS calculator](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/roas-calculator) to find your own break-even number.

### Meta ads agency vs an in-house media buyer: which is better?
An in-house buyer gives you one person and one skill set. An agency gives you media buying, creative production, CRO and tracking in one team, plus benchmarks from dozens of accounts in your niche. For brands under about $2M a month in revenue, an agency usually reaches profitable scale faster and costs less than hiring a full team.

### How do you scale DTC brands with retargeting after iOS 14?
We keep [retargeting](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/blog/retargeting-for-dtc-brands) small and let Advantage+ shopping campaigns and catalog ads do most of the work. Retargeting budgets run at roughly 10% to 15% of spend, use dynamic product ads for site visitors and cart abandoners, and are measured against blended [MER](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/glossary/mer) rather than platform-reported ROAS, so the account does not double count the same customers.

### How long until a new Meta ads account shows results?
The first 7 to 14 days are foundation work: tracking, offer, product page and the first creative batch. Most accounts see a clear winning angle inside the first 30 days and reach a stable scaling budget by day 60 to 90, depending on margin and creative volume.

### Do you only work with Shopify stores?
Shopify is the platform most of our clients use and the one our CRO team builds on, but the media buying and creative systems work for any DTC store with a tracked checkout. The requirement is product-market fit and enough margin to scale, not a specific platform.

      
## Which bid strategy we use, and when

      New tests start on lowest cost bidding while we learn what works. Once cost per purchase is stable, cost controls come in. [Bid caps](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/cases/why-your-facebook-ads-aren-scaling-fix-these-manual-bidding) and cost caps held a skincare account at 4.39x ROAS and a women's fashion account at 3.56x through [BFCM](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/blog/bfcm-meta-ads-playbook), and a [jewelry brand](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/case-studies/apparel-fashion) drove $54K in 7 days on manual bid caps.

      
      Bid strategyWhen we use itWatch out forLowest costNew tests, new products, limited dataCost per purchase drifts up as budget growsCost capProven ads where volume near a target cost mattersDelivery stops if the cap is set too lowBid capPeak periods and tight marginsNeeds daily adjustment or spend stalls
      
      - [$115,416 at 4.39x ROAS, skincare](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/cases/26271-spent-115416-generated-4-39-roas-skincare-brand-crushed-it)

    
      
## What to have ready before you hire a Meta agency

      Have three things ready on day one: admin access to the Business Manager, ad account, pixel and Shopify store; real product, shipping and fee costs so [break-even ROAS](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/tools/break-even-roas-calculator) can be set; and past creative with its results, failures included. Not ready to hand over the account? A one-off [Meta ads audit](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/meta-ads-audit) is a smaller first step.

# Ecommerce Ad Creative and Creative Testing for DTC Brands
URL: https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/viral-creatives
Summary: Ecommerce ad creative for DTC brands: hooks and angles on a testing matrix, and weekly creative testing that lowers CPA as Meta and TikTok spend grows.

Creative is the #1 targeting lever in modern Meta and TikTok advertising. We write, produce, and iterate 30 to 50+ fresh direct-response video angles every month to eliminate ad fatigue.

## What are direct response video ads?
Direct response video ads are short paid videos built to make a viewer act now: click, add to cart or buy. Unlike brand videos, they are judged on cost per purchase and ROAS. They open with a hook, show a problem and the product solving it, add proof and an offer, and are replaced often.

      
## Our Creative Testing Matrix

      We deploy psychological hooks, founder authority explainers, customer problem unboxings, and split-screen comparison tests engineered to maximize Thumbstop and Hold rates.

    
      
## Direct response video ads vs brand video

      A brand video is made to be remembered. A direct response video ad is made to be acted on, and it is judged by numbers you can see within days: thumb-stop rate, [click-through rate](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/glossary/ctr), cost per purchase and ROAS. That changes how it is made. Brand video is usually one polished piece with a long life. Direct response creative is many rougher variations, each testing a different hook or angle, with most of them retired within weeks.
The library on this page shows that approach across ecommerce and lead generation. Our core work is for DTC ecommerce brands, where the video's job is to sell a product to someone who had never heard of it a few seconds earlier.

      
      
      
      
    
      
## Anatomy of a direct response video ad

      Most of our ecommerce video ads follow the same five-part structure, whatever the format. The timings below are a guide for a 20 to 40 second ad; the hook is the part that matters most, because a viewer who scrolls past never sees the rest.

      
      PartTypical timingJobHookFirst 1 to 3 secondsStop the scroll with a problem, a claim, a reaction or an unexpected visualProblemNext 3 to 8 secondsMake the viewer feel the pain point the product solvesProduct and demoMiddle sectionShow the product working, ideally in real useProofMiddle to lateReviews, results, before and after, or numbersOffer and call to actionLast 3 to 5 secondsGive the reason to buy now and the next step
      
      
    
      
## How the hook and angle matrix produces 45+ ads

      We do not brief one video at a time. Each product gets a matrix: 5 angles, 3 hook styles and 3 formats, which gives 45+ distinct ads to test from a single round of research. An angle is the reason someone would buy, such as saving time, looking better, or fixing a specific problem. A hook style is how the first seconds open. A format is how the video is made.
Testing the matrix shows which angle wins first, then which hook and format sell that angle best. The winners are recut and re-hooked every week, which is how partner brands get 30 to 50+ new creatives a month without starting from a blank page each time.

      - Example angles: problem and solution, social proof, comparison with the alternative, founder story, offer-led.
- Example hook styles: a bold claim, a question to the viewer, a visual pattern interrupt.
- Example formats: UGC talking head, product demo, split-screen or before and after.

      
      
      
    
      
## From brief to weekly winners

      Briefs come from data, not taste: winning comments and reviews, competitor ads in the [Meta Ads Library](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/blog/meta-ads-library), and what the ad account already shows about which angles convert. Creators film to the brief, editors cut several hooks for each body, and new ads go into testing every week. UGC video production is handled with our sister studio, SevenFigureStudio, so volume does not depend on one freelancer's availability.
Every week the numbers decide what happens next. Ads that hold attention but do not sell get a new offer or call to action. Ads that sell but lose attention early get a new hook. Ads that do neither are switched off. Winners are given new hooks and formats so they last longer before fatigue.

      
      
      
      - SevenFigureStudio UGC video ads

    
## More questions

### How many video ads does a DTC brand need each month?
Enough to replace ads before they fatigue and to keep testing new angles. For brands spending $10K to $20K+ a month on Meta or TikTok, that usually means at least several new ads a week. Brand Scaling partners receive 30 to 50+ new creatives and angles a month, with the volume rising as spend scales.

### Do direct response video ads need real creators or customers?
Not always, but people on camera usually help on Meta and TikTok because the ad looks like content rather than an advert. We use paid UGC creators, founders and real customer footage where available, alongside demos and motion graphics. The format is chosen by testing, not by preference, and the matrix includes more than one format for each angle.

### How do you scale video ad creative without fatigue?
Treat creative as a testing pipeline, not single ads. Each week we launch new hooks on proven angles, keep the body and offer that already convert, read hook rate and hold rate in the first days, then move winners into the scaling campaign and retire ads whose CPA rises as frequency climbs. Volume of new angles, not budget, is what lets an account spend more at the same CPA.

### Who makes the UGC and video ads, and how is creative priced?
Brand Scaling writes the scripts, briefs and sources creators, edits the videos and launches them in the ad accounts it runs. Creative is priced as part of the growth engagement and quoted after the [Brand Growth Audit](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/book); partners typically spend at least $10,000 to $20,000 a month on ads.

### Which metrics show a video creative is ready to scale?
Look at hook rate (3-second views divided by impressions), hold rate, click-through rate and, above all, cost per purchase against your [break-even ROAS](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/tools/break-even-roas-calculator). An ad with a strong hook but a CPA above target needs a new body or offer; an ad at target CPA after a few days of spend is a candidate for the scaling campaign.

# Real ROAS Calculator for Ecommerce
URL: https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/roas-calculator
Summary: A real ROAS calculator for ecommerce: enter price, product cost, fees and CAC to get break-even ROAS, profit per order and monthly profit. Free, no signup.

Model your product pricing, product cost (COGS), and target customer acquisition cost (CAC) to calculate break-even ROAS and monthly net profit before scaling paid ad spend.

## How do you use a ROAS calculator?
Enter your selling price, your full cost per unit and the cost per purchase you pay or expect to pay. The ROAS calculator returns the ROAS your ads must report to hit that cost, the profit left on each order and a monthly profit estimate. Compare the required ROAS with what your account actually delivers.

      
## The Formulas

      ROAS = Total Ad Revenue / Total Ad Spend

      Break-Even ROAS = 1 / Gross Margin %

      
## Break-Even ROAS by Product Margin

      At 50% gross margin, your break-even ROAS is 2.0x. At 60% gross margin, break-even is 1.67x. At 70% gross margin, break-even is 1.43x.

    
## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is a good ROAS for ecommerce?
There is no universal number. [A good ROAS](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/blog/good-roas-for-ecommerce) is any figure reliably above your store's [break-even ROAS](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/tools/break-even-roas-calculator). For most brands with 55% to 75% gross margins, an attributed ROAS of 3.0x to 4.5x represents healthy, sustainable scaling efficiency.

### What is the difference between ROAS and MER?
ROAS measures top-line revenue attributed to a single ad platform or campaign. [MER](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/glossary/mer) (Marketing Efficiency Ratio, or [blended ROAS](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/glossary/blended-roas)) measures total business revenue divided by all marketing spend across Meta, Google, TikTok, and agencies combined.

### How do I lower my break-even ROAS?
You can lower your break-even ROAS by improving product gross margins, negotiating lower manufacturing costs, or introducing high-AOV bundles and quantity breaks on your Shopify store.

### Is this a real ROAS calculator for ecommerce or an estimate?
It is a real calculator: it uses your actual selling price, product cost, shipping and payment fees and target CAC to return break-even ROAS, profit per order and monthly net profit. The only estimates are the ones you type in, so use real numbers from your Shopify and ad account reports.

### What is the best profit optimization tool for DTC brands?
Start with a margin model like this calculator before buying software. Paid profit analytics tools add live order-level data from Shopify and ad platforms, which is worth it above roughly $100K a month in revenue. Below that, a weekly break-even ROAS and [contribution margin](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/glossary/contribution-margin) check covers most decisions.

      
## Worked example: reading the default numbers

      The calculator opens with an example product: a $69 retail price, a $14 product cost, a $22 cost per purchase and 30 orders a day. Here is how to read what it returns. These are example numbers, not a benchmark.
Required ROAS is 3.14x, which is $69 divided by $22. It is the ROAS your ad account has to report for a $22 cost per purchase to hold, assuming one unit per order. If Meta or TikTok shows 3.14x or more, you are at or below that cost. Net profit per order is $33: $69 minus $14 minus $22. Monthly figures assume 30 days, so 30 orders a day becomes 900 orders, $62,100 in revenue and $29,700 in net profit, a 47.8% net margin.
Required ROAS is not the same as [break-even ROAS](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/tools/break-even-roas-calculator). Break-even is the point where profit per order is zero: here $69 divided by the $55 left after product cost, about 1.25x. The gap between 1.25x and 3.14x is your room to spend more per customer before an order stops being profitable.

      
      
      
      
    
      
## What each result means and what to do with it

      Each output answers a different question. Use them together rather than chasing one number.

      
      ResultWhat it answersIf it looks wrongRequired ROASWhat ROAS must your ads show for this cost per purchase?If your account reports less, the real cost per purchase is higher than you enteredNet profit per orderHow much is left after product and ad cost?If it is negative, cut cost per purchase or raise order value with bundlesNet profit marginWhat share of revenue is profit before overheads?If it is thin, a small rise in ad costs will wipe it outMonthly revenue and net profitWhat does this volume add up to over 30 days?Check it covers fixed costs: salaries, apps, agency fees, software
      
      
    
      
## Why this is a real ROAS calculator, not just revenue divided by spend

      A basic ROAS calculator only divides revenue by ad spend, which tells you nothing about profit. A real ROAS calculator for ecommerce starts from what each order costs you: product, shipping, payment fees and the ad cost per purchase. From those it works out your break-even ROAS (the lowest ROAS where an order still pays for itself) and the profit or loss each order leaves at your current cost per purchase.
That is the difference between a dashboard number and a decision. A 3x ROAS can be excellent for a store with a 1.6x break-even and loss-making for a store with a 3.5x break-even. If you only need the break-even point from your margin, the break-even ROAS calculator does that in one step; to plan budget for a revenue goal, use the Facebook ads budget calculator.

      
      
      
      
    
      
## ACoS to ROAS: converting Amazon numbers

      Amazon reports ACoS (advertising cost of sale) instead of ROAS. ACoS is ad spend divided by ad revenue, so it is simply the inverse of ROAS. To convert, divide 1 by ACoS as a decimal; to go back, divide 1 by ROAS.

      
      ACoSEquivalent ROAS50%2.0x40%2.5x33%3.0x25%4.0x20%5.0x
      
      
    
      
## Using it as a Meta ads, Facebook ads, TikTok or dropshipping ROAS calculator

      The formula is the same on every channel: ROAS = revenue from ads / ad spend, and the ROAS you need is price / (price - cost per order). What changes is where you read the numbers and what goes into cost.

      - Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ads: compare the result with the Purchase ROAS column in Ads Manager, and with blended [MER](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/glossary/mer) from Shopify, because Meta can over-credit itself.
- [TikTok ads](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/tiktok-ads-agency): use the Complete Payment ROAS column, and check it against MER from Shopify, since in-app attribution often differs from what the store records.
- Dropshipping stores: include supplier price, shipping to the customer and payment fees in product cost; long shipping times also raise refunds, so add an allowance for them.
- Amazon: use the ACoS to ROAS table above.

      
      
      - [Meta ads agency](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/meta-ads-agency)

    
      
## Mistakes that make the result look better than it is

      The calculator is only as accurate as the inputs. These are the gaps we see most often when founders model their numbers.

      - Entering only the supplier price as product cost. Add shipping to the customer, packaging, payment processing fees and an allowance for returns.
- Using list price when most orders carry a discount code. Enter the average price customers actually pay.
- Using platform ROAS as the truth. Ad platforms can over-credit themselves, so check against blended MER from Shopify revenue and total ad spend.
- Treating net profit per order as take-home profit. It is before fixed overheads, so the monthly figure still has to cover the rest of the business.
- Ignoring repeat purchases. If customers reorder, a first order near break-even can still be worth buying. Model [lifetime value](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/glossary/ltv) separately.

      
      
      - [Break-even ROAS calculator](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/tools/break-even-roas-calculator)

# TikTok Ads Agency for Ecommerce Brands: Creator Ads, Spark Ads &amp; TikTok Shop
URL: https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/tiktok-ads-agency
Summary: TikTok ads agency for DTC brands: native creator ads, Spark Ads and in-feed campaigns, run with the same creative engine as Meta. Book a TikTok ads audit.

TikTok ads, Spark Ads, creator affiliates and TikTok Shop run as one system with the creative, the tracking and the Shopify store. Built by the team behind $50M+ in paid social spend and 150+ verified case studies.

## When should an ecommerce brand hire a TikTok ads agency?
Hire a TikTok ads agency once Meta is stable and you can supply native creator video every week. TikTok rewards volume and authenticity more than polish, so the agency's job is mostly creative: briefing creators, testing hooks and turning organic winners into Spark Ads that sell to your Shopify store.

        
## What a TikTok Ads Agency Does for an Ecommerce Brand

        A TikTok ads agency plans, produces and runs TikTok campaigns judged on revenue, cost per acquisition and ROAS: a steady supply of native creator videos, Spark Ads and in-feed campaigns that scale the winners, and TikTok Shop with affiliates where the product fits.

        
## Three Pillars

        
          - Native creator content briefed on a 45+ hook and angle matrix, with organic winners run as Spark Ads.

          - TikTok Shop scaling services: listings, affiliate creator recruitment, commissions, sample seeding and GMV Max.

          - Tracking and unit economics: TikTok Pixel and Events API validated against Shopify orders, blended MER across TikTok and Meta.

        
        
## How We Scale a TikTok Ads Account in 90 Days

        
          - Foundation (days 1 to 14): Pixel and Events API audit, TikTok Shop or catalog setup, offer and margin review.

          - Test (days 15 to 45): weekly creator drops, hook testing, Spark Ads on organic winners, affiliates seeded.

          - Optimize (days 45 to 90): Shop listing and landing page conversion, bundles, cost caps on proven ads.

          - Scale (day 90 onward): 20% to 30% budget steps, GMV Max, 40+ new videos a month, winners recut for Meta.

        
        [Meta ads agency](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/meta-ads-agency) | [All services](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/services) | [Direct-response creatives](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/viral-creatives) | [Case studies](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/case-studies) | [Contact](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/contact)

      
## Frequently Asked Questions

### What does a TikTok ads agency do for an ecommerce brand?
A TikTok ads agency produces native creator videos, runs in-feed and Spark Ads campaigns, and manages [TikTok Shop](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/tiktok-shop-agency) and affiliate creators where the product fits. Brand Scaling runs TikTok alongside Meta from one creative engine, so winning hooks are recut for both platforms and measured on blended [MER](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/glossary/mer).

### Do you also run TikTok Shop?
Yes, as a separate service from TikTok ads. We set up or audit the shop listing, recruit and brief affiliate creators, structure commissions and sample seeding, and run [GMV Max](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/blog/tiktok-gmv-max) and Spark Ads on the best affiliate videos, all tied to the same offer and margin model as your Shopify store. The details are on our TikTok Shop scaling services page.

### Are TikTok ads better than Meta ads for ecommerce?
Neither is better in general. Meta usually scales more predictably for most DTC brands; TikTok can win for visual, demo-friendly and impulse products with a younger audience. We test TikTok once creative supply and tracking are solid, and keep the budget on whichever channel delivers the lower new-customer CAC.

### How much should I spend on TikTok ads to start?
Plan on enough budget to exit learning on one campaign: roughly 20 to 50 times your target cost per purchase over the first two weeks, plus a creative budget for 8 to 12 new videos a week. Brand Scaling partners typically spend $10,000 to $20,000+ a month across paid social.

### What are Spark Ads?
Spark Ads run an existing organic TikTok post, from your account or a creator's with permission, as a paid ad. The post keeps its likes, comments and creator handle, which makes it look native and usually lowers cost per click compared with a standard in-feed ad.

### Do I need TikTok Shop to advertise on TikTok?
No. Many Shopify brands advertise on TikTok and send traffic to their own store. TikTok Shop adds in-app checkout and affiliate creators, which helps impulse products convert, but it is a separate decision we make based on margin, fulfilment and category.

      
## TikTok ads or TikTok Shop: which one you need

      This page is about TikTok advertising: in-feed and Spark Ads that send people to your own store. [TikTok Shop](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/tiktok-shop-agency) is a different model. The sale happens inside the app, affiliate creators earn a commission on each order, and the work is listings, samples and creator management as much as ads. It now has its own page.
The two can run together, but the decision is separate. TikTok ads suit brands that want customers and data on their own Shopify store, with [email and SMS](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/klaviyo-email-sms-agency) follow-up afterwards. TikTok Shop suits impulse-friendly products with healthy margins after commission, and brands willing to manage fulfilment and creator relationships inside TikTok.

      
      
      
      - [TikTok Shop agency](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/tiktok-shop-agency)

    
      
## How a TikTok brief differs from a Meta brief

      A Meta ad can open on a product shot. On TikTok an ad that looks like an ad is skipped, so we brief creators on the first two seconds, give them talking points instead of a script, and let them film in their own setting.

      - Open on a person, a reaction or a problem, not a logo or a packshot.
- Use native text overlays and the creator's own voice rather than polished voiceover.
- Show the product in use within the first few seconds.
- Ask for three or four hook variations from every creator.
- Get Spark Ads authorisation codes at the brief stage, not after a post performs.

      
      
      
    
      
## How to judge TikTok results fairly

      TikTok buyers often see an ad, leave, and buy later through search, Instagram or a direct visit, so TikTok's own dashboard and Shopify rarely agree. We judge the channel on three numbers together: the platform-reported cost per purchase, new-customer CAC in Shopify for the period, and blended [MER](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/glossary/mer) before and after TikTok spend started. If MER holds or improves as TikTok spend grows, the channel is adding customers, even when its in-platform ROAS looks lower than Meta's.

      
      
      
      - [Meta ads vs TikTok ads](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/compare/meta-ads-vs-tiktok-ads)

## Who our DTC performance marketing services are for

      Our DTC performance marketing services are built for brands that already sell. Most partners do somewhere between $20K and $2M+ a month in revenue, have product-market fit, and spend at least $10K to $20K a month on paid ads or are ready to. We work with brands in the US, the UK, Canada and Australia, mostly on Shopify.
Below that level the problem is usually finding a product or an offer that sells, and an agency retainer is rarely the best use of the money. Above it, the problem shifts to keeping efficiency as spend grows: more creative, a store that converts colder traffic, and retention that lifts [lifetime value](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/glossary/ltv) so the ad account can pay more for each new customer. That second problem is the one these services are designed for.

## How an engagement runs, from audit to scale

      Every engagement starts with a Brand Growth Audit: a 1-on-1 review with Gaurav Kapoor of your ad account, creative, store and unit economics. The output is a plan that names the two or three constraints holding growth back and the order to fix them in. You see it before any fee is agreed.
From there the work follows four phases. The timings are typical, not fixed: a brand with clean tracking and a strong offer moves through Foundation faster, and a brand with thin margins may spend longer in Optimize before budget goes up.

      
      PhaseTypical timingMain workFoundationDays 1 to 14Tracking and Conversions API, offer, margins, product pageTestDays 15 to 45Weekly creative on the hook and angle matrixOptimizeDays 45 to 90Conversion rate, AOV and ROAS worked on togetherScaleDay 90 onward20% to 30% budget steps, cost caps, 40+ assets a month, new markets and TikTok
      
      
    
      
## How DTC performance marketing services are priced

      Agencies in this space usually charge in one of four ways: a fixed monthly retainer, a percentage of ad spend, a performance fee tied to revenue or profit, or a mix of a base fee and a performance component. Each has a trade-off. A retainer is predictable but does not move with results. A percentage of spend rewards spending more, which is not always what the brand needs. A pure performance fee aligns incentives but depends on both sides agreeing what counts as performance.
Brand Scaling quotes after the audit, because the right scope depends on which services the brand needs and how much creative it will take. When you compare quotes from any agency, check three things: what creative volume is included, who owns the ad accounts and the store code, and which number the agency reports on. An agency judged on platform ROAS alone can look good while blended profit falls.

      
      
      
      
    
## More questions

### Which service should a DTC brand start with?
Start where the biggest constraint is. If tracking is broken, every other decision is built on bad data, so that comes first. If the ads work but stop working after a few weeks, the constraint is creative volume. If clicks are cheap but sales are not, it is the store or the offer. The Brand Growth Audit is how we find which one applies.

### Can I hire Brand Scaling for one channel only?
Yes. Some brands start with Meta ads or a Shopify rebuild alone. We will tell you during the audit if another part of the system is likely to cap results, for example a product page that cannot convert more traffic, but the scope is your decision. Many partners add services once the first channel is working and the next constraint shows up.

# TikTok Shop Agency for DTC Brands That Want In-App Sales to Pay
URL: https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/tiktok-shop-agency
Summary: TikTok Shop agency and scaling services for DTC brands: shop setup, listings, affiliate creators, LIVE, GMV Max and Spark Ads, run on your real margins.

[Home](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/) / [Services](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/services) / TikTok Shop Agency

        
        Brand Scaling works as a TikTok Shop agency for DTC brands that already sell on Shopify and want a second checkout inside the TikTok app. That means building the shop, writing listings that convert from a short video, recruiting affiliate creators who post about your product, running LIVE sessions, and putting ad budget behind the videos that already sell.
This page covers the shop itself. If you want TikTok in-feed ads that send traffic to your own website, that is a different job, covered on our [TikTok ads agency](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/tiktok-ads-agency) page at /tiktok-ads-agency. Many brands end up running both, but the setup, the metrics and the weekly work are not the same, so it helps to decide which problem you are solving first.

        
## What does a TikTok Shop agency do?
A TikTok Shop agency sets up and runs your in-app store: product listings, affiliate creator recruitment and free samples, LIVE shopping sessions, and paid amplification through GMV Max and Spark Ads. The job is to turn creator videos into orders at a commission and ad cost your margin can carry, then scale what sells.

        
        
        
          
## TikTok Shop vs TikTok ads: which one you actually need

          TikTok ads that link to Shopify are judged like any paid social channel: cost per purchase, new-customer CAC and blended [MER](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/glossary/mer). TikTok Shop works differently. The customer never leaves the app, a large share of sales can come from affiliate creators you pay on commission, and the platform's own campaigns optimise toward gross merchandise value (GMV) inside the shop.
That changes the economics. On TikTok Shop you are paying a platform referral fee, an affiliate commission on many orders, the cost of free samples, and sometimes ad spend on top. A product with thin margin can look busy and still lose money. Before we build anything, we model what each order costs you through each route so the shop is set up to make a profit, not just to post a big GMV number.

          
          QuestionTikTok ShopTikTok ads to ShopifyWhere checkout happensInside the TikTok appOn your own storeMain traffic sourceAffiliate creators, LIVE, shop tab, GMV MaxIn-feed and Spark AdsMain cost linesPlatform fee, commission, samples, adsAd spend and creativeCustomer data you keepLimitedFull, including email and SMSBest fitVisual, demo-able, impulse-priced productsMost DTC products with a strong offer
          
          
        
          
## TikTok Shop scaling services: what is included

          We run the shop as an operating channel, not a one-off setup. Each part below feeds the next: listings make creator videos convert, creator videos give us ad material, and ad spend gives the best videos the reach they need.

          
          
          
### Shop setup and product listings
We connect the shop to your catalogue, set shipping and fulfilment rules, and write listings for a buyer who arrived from a 20 second video. That means a clear first image, a title that says what the product does, variant and bundle options that lift order value, and a price that leaves room for commission.

### Affiliate creators and free samples
Affiliates are the engine of most TikTok Shops. We set an open commission for anyone who joins and higher targeted commissions for creators we invite, decide which creators get free samples, and send a short brief with the hooks and demos that already work in your ads. Samples go to creators whose audience and past videos match the product, and we track which ones post.

### LIVE shopping
LIVE sessions work best for products that need a demo or that suit limited-time offers. We plan the run of show, the offer ladder during the stream, and who hosts it, whether that is the founder, a team member or a paid creator.

### GMV Max and Spark Ads
Once affiliate videos are posting, we amplify the ones with real orders. [GMV Max](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/blog/tiktok-gmv-max) campaigns push shop sales using your catalogue and the creative TikTok can access, and Spark Ads put paid reach behind a specific organic post with the creator's permission. Budget follows proven videos, not guesses.

          
        
          
## How we scale a TikTok Shop

          Our process follows the same four phases we use across all channels, adapted to the shop.

          - Foundation, days 1 to 14: margin model per order route, shop and listings live, tracking between TikTok and Shopify inventory checked, first sample wave to creators.
- Test, days 15 to 45: weekly creator outreach and sample batches, new hooks and demos briefed from our 45+ cell hook and angle matrix, first GMV Max and Spark Ads tests on videos with orders.
- Optimise, days 45 to 90: commission rates adjusted by creator tier, bundles and offers tested on listings, LIVE sessions added if the product suits them.
- Scale, day 90 onward: budget steps of 20% to 30% on proven campaigns, more creators per month, and winning shop videos recut for Meta and TikTok ads.

          
          
          
        
          
## Who a TikTok Shop agency is right for

          TikTok Shop suits products that sell themselves on camera: skincare with a visible texture or before and after, beauty tools, fitness gear, supplements with a clear daily routine, gadgets and fashion items that look good in motion. It also suits brands with gross margins healthy enough to share a slice of each order with a creator.
It is a weaker fit for high-ticket products that need long consideration, items that cannot ship quickly in the market you sell to, or brands whose margin is already tight on Shopify. In those cases we will say so in the audit and point the budget to the channel that pays back.
Our typical partners already do about $20K to $2M+ a month in revenue with product-market fit. A new brand can open a TikTok Shop, but it rarely makes sense to make the shop the first channel before the offer is proven.

          
          
          
          
        
          
## How TikTok Shop agency pricing works

          TikTok Shop agencies usually charge a monthly retainer, a percentage of shop GMV or ad spend, a performance fee, or a mix. Some also charge a setup fee for the first build. Sample costs and affiliate commissions are paid by the brand on top, so make sure any quote you compare includes them.
We quote after a [Brand Growth Audit](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/book), a 1-on-1 review with Gaurav of your margins, creative, current channels and store. You see the plan and the expected cost structure before any fee is agreed. We have not published TikTok Shop [case studies](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/case-studies) yet, so we will not quote you shop-specific results. What we can show you is how the same creative system performs across our paid social accounts in our case studies.

## Frequently asked questions

### What do TikTok Shop scaling services include?
TikTok Shop scaling services cover the whole shop, not only ads: setting up the shop and product listings, recruiting and briefing affiliate creators, managing free samples and commissions, running LIVE sessions, and putting GMV Max and Spark Ads budget behind the videos that already sell. Budgets rise in steps only while margin after fees, commissions and ads stays positive.

### How is a TikTok Shop agency different from a TikTok ads agency?
A TikTok ads agency runs paid campaigns that usually send people to your own website. A TikTok Shop agency runs the in-app store: listings, affiliate creators, samples, LIVE sessions and GMV Max. The two overlap on creative and Spark Ads, so we often run them together, but the costs and metrics differ.

### How much commission should I offer TikTok Shop affiliates?
Set it from your margin, not from what competitors advertise. Work out the profit per order after product cost, shipping and platform fees, then decide how much of that you can share. We usually run a lower open commission for anyone and higher targeted rates for creators whose content and audience fit the product.

### Should I send free samples to every creator who asks?
No. Free samples cost product and shipping, and many requests come from accounts that never post. We screen requests by audience fit, past video quality and whether the creator has sold similar products, then track who posts. Creators who post and sell get the next sample and a better commission.

### What is GMV Max on TikTok Shop?
GMV Max is a TikTok Shop campaign type that optimises toward shop sales using your product catalogue and eligible videos, including affiliate content. You set a budget and a return target and the system chooses placements and creative. It works best once you already have several videos that have produced orders.

### Will TikTok Shop take sales away from my Shopify store?
Some customers who would have bought on your site will buy in the app instead, and some shop buyers will later find your site. The real question is whether total [contribution margin](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/glossary/contribution-margin) rises. We track shop orders, site orders and blended MER together so you can see if the shop is adding profit or just moving it.

### Do you run TikTok Shop outside the US?
We work with brands selling into the US, UK, Canada and Australia. TikTok Shop availability and rules vary by country and change over time, so in the audit we confirm whether the shop is open in your markets and what fulfilment you need before building anything.

# Google Shopping Ads Agency for DTC Brands Running Paid Social
URL: https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/google-shopping-ads-agency
Summary: Google Shopping ads agency for DTC brands: Merchant Center feeds, Performance Max, brand vs non-brand split and target ROAS set from your real margins.

[Home](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/) / [Services](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/services) / Google Shopping Ads

        
        Brand Scaling runs Google as a Google Shopping ads agency for DTC brands whose growth is led by Meta and TikTok. Paid social creates demand. People see an ad, then search for the product or the brand on Google and buy. Shopping and Performance Max are where much of that demand gets captured, and where a lot of budget quietly goes to waste when the feed is weak or branded searches are mixed in with real prospecting.
Our job on Google is narrow and practical: a clean product feed, a campaign structure that tells you what is new revenue and what is not, and a return target that comes from your margin rather than from a default setting.

        
## What does a Google Shopping ads agency do?
A Google Shopping ads agency builds and maintains your Merchant Center product feed, runs Shopping and Performance Max campaigns, separates branded from non-branded demand, and sets target ROAS from your margins. For DTC brands it also makes sure Google captures the search demand that Meta and TikTok create without taking credit for it twice.

        
        
        
          
## Start with the Merchant Center feed

          Shopping ads are built from your product feed, not from ad copy. Google reads your titles, descriptions, images, prices, product types and custom labels to decide which searches your products appear for. A feed pushed straight from Shopify with default titles usually leaves a lot on the table.
We fix the feed before we touch bids.

          - Titles rewritten with the words people actually search: product type, key attribute, size or count, then brand where it helps.
- Images checked for policy and clarity, with variant images mapped correctly.
- Product types and Google product categories set so similar items group together.
- Custom labels added for margin tier, bestseller status, price band and seasonality, so campaigns can be split by profitability.
- Disapprovals, price mismatches and shipping errors cleared in Merchant Center.
- Promotions and product ratings connected where you qualify.

          
          
          
        
          
## Brand vs non-brand: the split that changes everything

          If someone searches your brand name, they already know you, often because of a Meta or TikTok ad. Shopping and Performance Max will happily serve on those searches and report a very high ROAS. That number is real revenue but it is not new demand, and it can hide the fact that non-branded campaigns are losing money.
We separate the two. Branded search gets a modest budget to protect your name from competitors and resellers. Non-branded Shopping and Performance Max, the searches for the product category, get judged on their own ROAS and on new-customer acquisition. Where the account allows, we use brand exclusions on Performance Max and negative keywords on Standard Shopping so the reporting stays honest.
This matters for budget decisions across channels. If Google takes credit for sales Meta created, you might cut the Meta spend that was feeding it.

          
          
          
          
        
          
## Performance Max and Standard Shopping

          Performance Max runs across Shopping, Search, YouTube, Display, Discover and Gmail from one campaign. It can scale well with a strong feed and good conversion data, but it gives less control and less visibility. Standard Shopping gives you search term data and tighter control over what you bid on.
For most DTC brands we run a mix: Performance Max segmented by margin tier or product group using custom labels, plus Standard Shopping for hero products or categories where we want search-term control. Asset groups get real creative, often cut from the same [UGC](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/viral-creatives) and product videos that work on Meta, rather than auto-generated assets.

          
          
          
          
        
          
## Setting target ROAS from your margins

          Target ROAS should come from [contribution margin](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/glossary/contribution-margin), not a round number. The [break-even ROAS](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/tools/break-even-roas-calculator) on a product is 1 divided by its contribution margin percentage. As a worked example: a product with 50% margin after product cost, shipping and fees breaks even at 2.0x, while one at 35% margin needs about 2.86x just to break even.
We set targets per margin tier so high-margin products can bid more aggressively and low-margin ones are held to a stricter return. Because branded traffic is split out, these targets apply to real prospecting, which is where the profit question actually sits. You can work out your own number with our break-even [ROAS calculator](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/roas-calculator) at /tools/break-even-roas-calculator.

          
          
          
          
        
          
## How Google works alongside Meta and TikTok

          Most of our partners spend the majority of their paid budget on Meta, and Google acts as the capture layer. We read the two together. When a new Meta angle starts scaling, branded and category searches often rise, and Shopping should be ready for it with stock, feed and budget.
We report blended [MER](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/glossary/mer) and new-customer CAC across all channels weekly, so you can see whether Google spend is adding customers or mostly collecting ones you already paid for elsewhere. If you are deciding how to split budget, our comparison at /compare/meta-ads-vs-google-ads covers the trade-offs.

          
          
          
          
        
          
## Common problems we find in DTC Google accounts

          Most Google accounts we audit for paid social brands have the same handful of issues. None of them need a bigger budget to fix, and several can be cleared in the first two weeks.

          - Branded and non-branded searches in one campaign, so the reported ROAS looks healthy while prospecting loses money.
- Conversion tracking counting more than purchases, such as add to carts or page views, which teaches bidding to chase the wrong action.
- One target ROAS across every product, regardless of margin, so low-margin items soak up budget.
- Products with disapprovals or out-of-stock variants still eating impressions and clicks.
- Performance Max running on auto-generated assets with no real video, which weakens YouTube and Display placements.
- No custom labels, so there is no way to separate bestsellers from slow movers or new launches from clearance stock.
- Google reporting compared only against itself instead of against Shopify orders and blended MER.

          
          
          
        
          
## Pricing and what to expect

          Google Shopping agencies usually charge a monthly retainer, a percentage of ad spend, a performance fee, or a mix. Feed work is sometimes billed as a separate setup project. We quote after a [Brand Growth Audit](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/book) with Gaurav, which covers your ad accounts, feed, store and unit economics.
We have not published Google Shopping [case studies](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/case-studies), so we will not promise you a Google ROAS. What we will show you in the audit is where your current Google spend is going, how much of it is branded, and what the feed changes and structure would be.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is Performance Max better than Standard Shopping for ecommerce?
Neither wins every time. Performance Max can scale further with a strong feed and good conversion data, but it hides search terms and mixes in branded traffic. Standard Shopping gives more control. Most DTC accounts we see do best with a mix, segmented by margin or product group, with branded searches kept separate.

### Why is my Google Shopping ROAS high but profit low?
Usually because branded searches are inside the same campaigns. People who already know your brand convert at a very high rate, which lifts reported ROAS while non-branded prospecting loses money. Splitting brand from non-brand, and setting target ROAS by margin tier, normally shows where the profit actually sits.

### How do I optimise my Merchant Center product feed?
Rewrite titles with the terms people search for, starting with product type and key attributes. Fix image and price errors, set accurate product categories, and add custom labels for margin, bestsellers and price bands. Clear disapprovals regularly. A better feed improves which searches you show for before any bid change.

### Should DTC brands run Google Shopping if Meta is working?
Usually yes, as a capture channel. Meta and [TikTok ads](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/tiktok-ads-agency) create searches for your product and brand. If you are not on Shopping, competitors and resellers can take those buyers. The key is to measure Google on new customers and blended MER so it does not take credit for demand paid social created.

### What target ROAS should I set on Google Shopping?
Start from break-even: 1 divided by your contribution margin percentage. A product with 40% margin breaks even at 2.5x. Set your target above break-even for the profit you want, and use different targets per margin tier. Avoid one account-wide target, which over-bids on low-margin products and under-bids on high-margin ones.
